# Luca Valentini

> Senior Unity Developer, Systems & Tools Programmer.

Senior Unity Developer with 6+ years in Unity and C#, in studio teams since 2023. I build structured, self-contained game systems and the custom editor tooling that makes the whole team faster, backed by measured performance work on mobile.

- **Availability:** Available now for Senior Unity Developer roles, remote, worldwide. Contractor from Argentina is fine.
- **Location:** Buenos Aires, Argentina (remote)
- **Email:** lucavalentini25@gmail.com

- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/lucavalentinidev

## Experience

### Senior Unity Developer · KYKUYO
Jan 2025 to Sep 2026 · Remote

Worked on SOLAR, a live free-to-play geolocation/AR mobile game on Google Play and the App Store.

- Owned the character dressing system end-to-end: a node-graph garment system with backend sync and 8 authoring tools.
- Built the NPC GPU rendering pipeline: 10 to 200 fps measured on device with a full NPC crowd.
- Designed the camera context system, with the layer boundary enforced by the compiler.
- Took the technical direction of SPCA x SOLAR across a 9-person team.
- Shipped the onboarding flow, the in-app purchase store and the HUD.
- Built internal editor tooling used across the team: 9 of the project's 35 custom editor tools.

### Professor / Teaching Assistant · Escuela Da Vinci
Mar 2025 to Present · Buenos Aires, Argentina

Professor of Artificial Intelligence and pathfinding algorithms (2026 to present). Teaching Assistant in Programming for Thesis (2025).

- Teaches Artificial Intelligence and pathfinding algorithms.
- Helped students plan and architect the systems behind their thesis projects.

### Lead Unity Developer · 3AM Games Studio
Jan 2023 to Present · Buenos Aires, Argentina

Indie project alongside full-time work. Technical direction of Waxy: The Wick and the Witch, over 26 months in a 5-person team.

- Wrote 10 of the project's 14 custom editor tools.
- Led a full rework of the core mechanic, which got the project selected for the ADVA MPVP mentorship program.
- Designed the wax and fire-state mechanics and the camera system.

### Technical Support Analyst & Helpdesk · Huawei Technologies
Sep 2023 to Dec 2024 · Argentina, 100% in English

- Handled 300 to 400 support tickets a month against an under-18-hour response-time SLA.
- Kept a user satisfaction rating of 4.5/5 or higher.

## Projects

### SOLAR
Live free-to-play geolocation/AR mobile game.

- **Role:** Senior Unity Developer at KYKUYO
- **Result:** Owned the dressing system, the camera-context architecture and the NPC GPU rendering pipeline (10 to 200 fps on device).
- **Stack:** Unity, C#, URP, Addressables, UI Toolkit, Jobs System, Burst
- **Link:** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kykuyo.solar
- **Trailer:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=amg94xwi4qA

### Waxy: The Wick and the Witch
3D puzzle-platformer by 3AM Games Studio. Wax is your health, your height as you melt, and the reach of your flame. Fully playable on a gamepad, menus included.

- **Role:** Lead Unity Developer, 5-person team
- **Result:** Led the rework of the core mechanic that got the project selected for the ADVA MPVP mentorship program; wrote 10 of its 14 custom editor tools.
- **Stack:** Unity, C#, Editor tools, Cinemachine, uGUI
- **Link:** https://3amgamesstudio.itch.io/waxy-the-wick-and-the-witch
- **Trailer:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ym1u3FD-qyw

### Snackdown
2D last-player-standing multiplayer platformer, server-authoritative, with hand-written client-side prediction, server reconciliation and snapshot interpolation. Built with Claude Code.

- **Role:** Sole author
- **Result:** Measured 0.302 units median prediction error at 20% packet loss, and 2 corrections in 79 seconds on a home network. Up to 4 players, host over Unity Relay.
- **Stack:** Unity 6, C#, Netcode for GameObjects, Unity Transport, Relay, Lobby
- **Link:** https://github.com/LucaValentini25/Snackdown

### Rollgeon
Roguelike dice builder where your deck is a bag of dice and combat is based on Generala. In development.

- **Role:** Mobile port and gamepad support, in collaboration with members of 3AM Games
- **Result:** Porting the game to mobile and adding controller support.
- **Stack:** Unity, Mobile port, Input System, Gamepad
- **Link:** https://3amgamesstudio.itch.io/rollgeon

### SPCA x SOLAR
Time-limited cat-rescue campaign game with SPCA, an animal rescue in Singapore. The campaign has ended.

- **Role:** Technical direction, 9-person team
- **Result:** Delivered within a fixed campaign window, with a mock layer so the game never waited on the backend.
- **Stack:** Unity, C#, Mobile, Addressables

### Unity Tools
Five Unity editor tools published as UPM packages: Asset Renamer, PlayerPrefs Manager, Prefab Replacer, Project Zipper and Rename Items.

- **Role:** Sole author
- **Result:** The Asset Renamer runs in SOLAR, a shipped commercial game.
- **Stack:** C#, UPM, Editor Windows
- **Link:** https://github.com/LucaValentini25/Unity-Tools

### You Can't Always Push the Red Button
Decision-making game for the Unity BA Game Jam 2026: you rule a cat nation and try not to just push the button. Made with Claude Code in 3 days.

- **Role:** Programming, shared with Ignacio Martinez, 3-person team
- **Result:** Playable WebGL build on itch.io; decision system co-designed and balanced with Ignacio.
- **Stack:** Unity, C#, WebGL, Claude Code
- **Link:** https://zathmell.itch.io/you-cant-always-push-the-red-button

### Indie Community Bot
Reusable Discord bot for indie game communities: welcome cards, devlogs, build notifications from CI and bug reports as private threads. All settings live per server in the database.

- **Role:** Sole author
- **Result:** Running on Rollgeon's community server.
- **Stack:** TypeScript, discord.js, SQLite
- **Link:** https://github.com/LucaValentini25/indie-community-bot

### Brain App
Local-first AI assistant where the LLM never decides an action: it classifies intent, and deterministic code does the work. Private repository.

- **Role:** Solo developer, personal project
- **Result:** 323 test cases that run green in 77 seconds, 17 architecture decisions, 54 endpoints.
- **Stack:** Python, FastAPI, SQLite, Vue 3, Ollama

## Case studies

- [The repetitive work that was eating level production](https://lucavalentini25.github.io/work.html#waxy-tools) (Waxy): 10 of the project's 14 custom editor tools, each aimed at a specific piece of manual work, including batch blockout-to-prefab conversion and localization key assignment across Timelines.
- [Filling a mobile city with NPCs without killing the frame](https://lucavalentini25.github.io/work.html#npc-gpu) (SOLAR): GPU skinning with a custom animation baker and draws grouped by mesh: 10 to 200 fps measured on device.
- [Internal tooling for the work nobody should do by hand](https://lucavalentini25.github.io/work.html#kykuyo-tooling) (SOLAR): Named editor utilities the whole team uses: Addressables Folder Manager, a build-and-API suite and a Mesh Instance Baker. 9 of the project's 35 editor tools.
- [A dressing system that survives every content drop](https://lucavalentini25.github.io/work.html#dressing) (SOLAR): Garments described as data in a node graph, synced with the backend catalogue, authored through 8 purpose-built tools, feeding both the player and the NPC crowd.
- [When everything wants to control the camera](https://lucavalentini25.github.io/work.html#camera) (SOLAR): Single-authority camera state arbitrated once per frame, in an assembly that deliberately doesn't reference Cinemachine, so bypassing it is a compile error.
- [Building the tool where the problem actually is](https://lucavalentini25.github.io/work.html#external) (Personal prototype): A Slack bot that turns a message into a tracked ticket, backed by Google Sheets. A working prototype.
- [Making a multiplayer platformer the server can trust](https://lucavalentini25.github.io/work.html#snackdown) (Snackdown): Server-authoritative rebuild with hand-written prediction and reconciliation on a 30 Hz tick; 0.302 units median prediction error at 20% packet loss.
